definitions.gloss: to throw; to toss; to hurl carelessly
definitions.explanation: To throw something with a careless or forceful motion, without much concern for where it lands.

definitions.gloss: to abandon; to give up on; to quit partway through
definitions.explanation: To stop doing something midway and walk away from it. Implies irresponsibility or frustration.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{放|ほう}る→放る：03939_houru⟧ (to throw, to toss) + ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw). The combination intensifies the carelessness or force of the throw. Both senses carry a nuance of roughness or disregard.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to abandon one's work
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to toss a ball
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to give up on everything
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to quit midway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投|な}げ{出|だ}す→投げ出す：10589_nagedasu⟧ — to throw out, to abandon (very similar to sense 2; equally common)
- ⟦{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す→放り出す：16163_houridasu⟧ — to throw out, to eject (emphasizes expulsion or abandonment)
- ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ — to throw (neutral; lacks the careless or rough nuance)
